items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Jimmy Cobb’s on the cymbal. And it was on man.

ctx.x: Oh, the biggest impression of that. It grabbed me, Monk. He turned the music on and I listened and what was there — well the first tune was “So What” on the record, was “So What.” And the introduction and the bass, the you know, the free bass line that was there
then into the melody and it just — Jimmy Cobb’s on the cymbal. And it was on man. And yeah. That’s what grabbed me. And there’s no other explanation.
When you heard Cannonball followed by Coltrane, were you at the point — this is seventh grade now — can you recall a preference or distinguishing one from the other?
